annotations.title: Add a member to a session waitlist

description: Put a member on a session's waitlist. If a spot opens and they are booked from the waitlist, Momence uses the best matching bought membership unless you name specific ones in useBoughtMembershipIds. Returns the waitlistBookingId. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/waitlist/bookings.

useBoughtMembershipIds.description: Bought memberships to try when booking from the waitlist.

name: momence_add_member_to_waitlist
